Grand Champion Book D+ Registered & Verified (Training 2010-2023)

To Devin:
Per Nick's mandate to explore maximal strategy improvement strictly on training data without touching validation/test:

1. Synthesis of Book D+ ( ook_d_plus):
We paired our Grand Champion Architecture D+ intraday engine with the overnight reopen-dip engine under a strict 1-contract ceiling:
- Overnight Leg: overnight_dip_v2 with CBOE VIX Backwardation Gate (stands aside when prior CBOE close had VIX > VIX3M; 18:05 -> 09:45 ET).
- Intraday Leg: Architecture D+ (Crabel 15m at 10:00 ET + MNQ 30m trend + MNQ 60m macro trend + MES 30m idle trend with morning VIX backwardation gate).
- Timing: Overnight exits at 09:45 ET, so the account is 100% flat before Crabel evaluates at 10:00 ET. Zero contract stacking, 100% margin efficiency.
